name: MassJ.jl
description: MassJ.jl is a Julia package for loading, processing, and analysing mass spectrometry data. It supports the common open file formats (mzML, mzXML, MGF, MSP, imzML), provides signal-processing tools (Savitzky-Golay smoothing, centroiding, baseline correction), isotopic distribution calculations, UniDec-style charge-state deconvolution, energy-resolved peak yields with per-scan error propagation, and Plots.jl recipes for native plotting.
